risk_note: Test only: four blocks of B2-09r's frozen recheck.int.test.ts, declared modify_existing flake_fix under D10-701 (CT-06zzzg). CI went red at random on [AC-B2-09r#2]: the waiting check read the worker's previous users statement while it already waited on the balance lock, because pg_stat_activity's query and wait_event are not read at the same moment. The orchestrator named #2 and #4; #1 and #3 use the same waiting() and are declared too.
